text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also raises important ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If AI systems learn from data that contains unfair patterns, they can make biased decisions, for example in hiring or lending. This is why fairness must be a priority when designing these tools. Another issue is privacy. AI often collects huge amounts of personal information, so developers must protect user data and use it responsibly. Transparency is also key—people should understand how and why an AI makes its choices. Ultimately, responsible AI development means thinking carefully about these risks, involving diverse teams, and creating systems that benefit everyone without causing harm.
